items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge class combiner. Every primitive in this library calls it with the caller's className last.

items.name: ui-styles
items.title: ui-styles
items.description: Shared class recipes (section labels, icon controls, text fields) used by input and sidebar.

items.name: color-themes
items.title: color-themes
items.description: Ten complete --app-* palettes plus appThemeCssVars() to apply one at runtime.

items.name: styles
items.title: Tokens & base styles
items.description: --app-* token definitions, theme palette wiring and base keyframes. Install once per app; every component below depends on these variables existing.

items.name: compat-shadcn
items.title: shadcn token compat layer
items.description: Optional bridge that maps shadcn's semantic tokens (bg-primary, border-border, ...) onto --app-*, for apps mid-migration off shadcn. Scheduled for deletion in v2 — do not add new dependents.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Flat button geometry: transparent 1px rest state, no elevation, cva variants for size and intent.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Segmented group of buttons sharing one boundary, divided by a Separator.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month-grid calendar over react-day-picker, restyled for the flat design system.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Filterable command list over cmdk; CommandDialog wraps it in a command-palette overlay.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog root over radix-ui, with a close Button wired into DialogContent.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu root over radix-ui: trigger, content, items, checkbox/radio items, sub-menus.

items.name: error-boundary
items.title: Error Boundary
items.description: Class-based error boundary with a flat fallback UI and reset control. Server-safe.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with optional leading icon and clear button, built on ui-styles' field recipe.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover root over radix-ui: trigger, content, anchor.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Row or column of resizable panels over react-resizable-panels.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select root over radix-ui: trigger, content, groups, items, scroll buttons.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Thin rule that divides content, either horizontally or vertically.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app rail/sidebar shell with its own class recipes via ui-styles.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder block shown while content loads. Server-safe.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs root over radix-ui: list, trigger, content.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip provider/root over radix-ui, with shared open/close timing.
